elements.quote: All English-language, full-text, clinical studies examining the use of MSCs or their secretome (MSC-EVs, MSC-CM) as a therapeutic intervention for COVID-19 were included.

elements.quote: In a recently reported systematic review examining the ef fi - cacy of MSCs for ARDS, overall mortality appeared reduced, although not statistically different in the MSC group compared with the control group (RR, 0.63; 95% CI, 0.21 to 1.93; P = .064; I 2 = 35.8%) [49]. ...
